styleLock.direction: cool porcelain matte mud-finish lip colour commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless cool porcelain white #FFFFFF for packshots, texture walls and swatch charts, alternating with lotus-ash matte panels #E7DCE0 and one deep plum-ash field #4A3A45; the cool rose hairline #C25C77 is only ever a rule line, never a lip or swatch hue, because every shade value is carried by the accent placeholder
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key cool studio light, front-left softbox key with a fill card, butterfly light on skin crops, skimming sweep across matte swatch ridges, soft contact shadows only, never a wet specular on a velvet finish
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless cool white sweep plus lotus-ash matte boards #E7DCE0 laid flat for overhead work and one deep plum-ash board #4A3A45 under the grid walls, no horizon and no table edge visible
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif only: one oversized headline, one thin numeral column and small label lines, all in-image copy supplied at generation time as placeholders
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight hairline rules and blank rounded label pills outlined in cool rose #C25C77, oversized translucent numerals for the numbered claim list, no filled illustrative icons and no tick, cross or arrow graphics
styleLock.presentationRules: one open-tube-with-flocked-applicator anchor reused at stable scale, formula always rendered as powdery velvet with feathered swipe edges, every skin crop taken at the nose so no identity shows, and every lip or swatch hue carried by the accent placeholder instead of a fixed shade
noDrift: no fixed lip shade hue across the set
no glossy finish on a matte product
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool porcelain matte lip colour visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless cool porcelain white #FFFFFF, lotus-ash #E7DCE0, deep plum-ash #4A3A45 and one cool rose hairline accent #C25C77, with every lip and swatch hue carried by one accent placeholder; bright even high-key cool studio lighting with a front-left softbox key and fill card, butterfly light on skin crops, skimming sweep across matte swatch ridges, soft contact shadows and no wet speculars; modern geometric sans-serif typography only; thin single-weight hairline rules, oversized translucent numerals and blank rounded label pills; stable open-tube-with-applicator anchor angle and scale with powdery feathered swipe edges; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：1 瓷白底上一支开盖细圆管，绒毛斜头刷杆自管身抽出、盖体立于旁，身后一大片抹开的雾面泥状色块；2 斜向叠压的泥状色带铺满画面，左下并列开盖管身与刷杆，右侧五组大号数字配短句主张；3 雾面唇部大特写嵌在瓷白版面中，右侧立开盖管身与刷头，上下留标题带与小字带；4、5、6 三张同版式三行三列唇部宫格选色页，每格下一条色带配编号字样，仅换一组试色唇色；7 两条并列前臂各一排矩形色块试色，每块配编号字样，浅灰底；8 四行四列方形质地微距色块墙，每块中央带编号字样。分镜处理：4、5、6 三页同构图合并为一镜选色墙，前臂色块排与质地微距墙各成一镜，薄涂厚涂双栏自第 3 图叠涂主张的结构推出，收口信任镜取第 1 图的器形组件并全部改为空白标贴与空白印章框，共 8 镜。品类判定：全部图像围绕唇部着色产品的雾面成膜质地、上唇妆效与选色体系展开，属着色彩妆而非护理清洁，故判美妆彩妆/唇部，与主会话品类提示一致（源图另示唇颊两用，主用仍为唇部）。已剥离：原品牌字标、系列名与管身环形字样、色号字母数字编号、原图英文文案原句（含持妆时长数字与遮盖唇纹一类断言）、模特面容与身份、原平台角标与店铺字样，一律改为 {product} 占位、{selling_point_n} 与 {callout_n} 占位、未印色块与空白标签位；唇色与全部试色色相一律由 {accent_color} 承载，不锁死具体色号色值；人物仅保留自鼻部裁掉的匿名下半脸与前臂手部。色板与背景体系改用冷调瓷白、藕雾灰、暗梅灰，与库内既有暖调唇部模版的陶土色系区分。
